name: Bathysphere
piloting: Crafting (DC 22), Engineering Lore (DC 20), or Piloting Lore (DC 20)

items.name: Cable
items.text: The bathysphere is raised and lowered from a cable at the surface and can move only vertically.

items.name: Tether Buoy
items.text: Crew and passengers can breathe while the vehicle is underwater to a depth of 500 feet or less.

items.name: Ballast Release
items.text: The pilot releases the bathysphere's ballast. The bathysphere moves 3 times its Speed toward the surface at the end of the pilot's turn.
